nodes.label: Environment trap — two databases named `local`
nodes.rationale: Local gives each site its own MySQL socket and names every database `local`. The wrong socket silently pairs one site's files with another site's database and everything appears to work. It produced a confidently-reported '496 orphaned attachments' finding that was fiction, plus a spec built on top of it.

nodes.label: Incident — 54 backups destroyed by a glob cleanup
nodes.rationale: A test harness cleaned up with a glob over the shared backup root and destroyed 54 real user backups. Every harness since deletes only paths resolved from its own records - never by scanning a directory.

nodes.label: Release gate for .org submission
nodes.rationale: I-3, I-4 and I-6 are now struck through; the remaining gates are I-1 (PHPCS) and I-2 (suite tests cwebp while the site runs Imagick), both already closed by units elsewhere in the tracker.
